info.title: runic-translations
info.description: Deterministic validation and generation tool for Runic Translations.

commands.name: completion
commands.description: Generate bash, zsh, fish or PowerShell completions

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate translation artifacts.

options.name: --project
options.description:
Translations directory or its runic.json. Defaults to
./runic.json, then ./translations/runic.json.

options.name: --output
options.description: Directory to write the artifacts to. [required]

options.name: --emit-csharp
options.description: Render the typed C# API.

options.name: --emit-json
options.description: Render locale-v5 JSON and its asset manifest.

options.name: --emit-esm
options.description:
Render the ESM package and
web-module-manifest-v3.json.

options.name: --pseudo-locales
options.description:
Also generate the development pseudo-locales that
runic.json declares in pseudoLocales (en-XA, ar-XB).

options.name: --contract
options.description:
A locale artifact (<catalog>.<locale>.locale-v5.json)
of a shipped release: the locale-v5 JSON then holds,
for each locale that release declares, only the
messages it accepts, stamped with its contract
fingerprint.

options.name: --overrides
options.description:
Compile the project, a library catalog, with an
application's override sources (the <locale>.rmf2
files of translations/overrides/<catalog>/),
validated per key.

options.name: --locales
options.description:
Keep only the library locales that these application
locales resolve to, with their fallbacks and the base
locale (comma-separated).

options.name: --shared-runtime
options.description:
Generate ESM whose runtime.js takes its code from
runtime-core.js beside the catalog directory, shared
by every catalog generated into the output directory.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version

commands.description: Validate catalogs and report translation diagnostics.

options.name: --project
options.description:

commands.description: Import a translated XLIFF document into the .rmf2 or .mf2 sources.

options.name: --project
options.description:

to ./runic.json, then ./translations/runic.json.

options.name: --source
options.description: The XLIFF document to import. [required]

options.name: --source-changed
options.description:
needs-review (default) applies a unit whose source
changed since export as needs-review; refuse
refuses it.

options.name: --review
options.description:
Write review state to <catalog>.review.json even
when it does not exist yet.

options.name: --fail-on
options.description:
refused: fail (exit 2) and write nothing when any
unit is refused. By default refused units are
warnings and the rest is applied.
